primary.purpose: Playback, frame selection, focus and text selection.

brand.purpose: Header wordmark; reduces to 18px on mobile.

headline.purpose: Sidebar heading; reduces to 16px on mobile.

body.purpose: Short supporting text in the project sidebar.

measurement.purpose: Dimensions and frame numbers; timing uses 10px and zoom uses 12px.

shadows.name: artboard
shadows.purpose: Separates the artboard from the canvas surround.

motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Button hover feedback; removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

breakpoints.name: compact-sidebar
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: 210px sidebar, reduced insets, wrapping timeline controls.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: stacked shell, two-column examples, native Project details disclosure.

components.name: Playback Button
components.description: Primary playback action with visible hover and keyboard focus states.
components.css: .play { font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 9px 13px; min-width: 68px; background: #b0db88; color: #203020; border: 1px solid #b0db88; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .play:hover { background: #c4e7a6; } .play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b0db88; outline-offset: 3px; } .play:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .play { transition: none; } }

components.name: Mobile Project Details
components.description: Native disclosure preserves mobile access to metadata and palette; shown at a maximum viewport width of 580px in the application.
components.css: .project { background: #181c20; color: #a7b2bc; padding: 16px 20px; font: 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .project summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 0; } .project summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b0db88; outline-offset: 3px; } .project dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 13px; margin: 0; padding: 12px 0 16px; } .project dd { margin: 0; color: #e5e9ec; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: A clean, lightweight developer tool. Charcoal surfaces recede around pixel artwork; precise controls and restrained green state cues support inspection. The interface is compact and practical, with native browser controls and system typography.

rules.name: Pixel Fidelity
rules.body: Preserve exact pixel zoom and allow oversized artwork to scroll rather than shrink responsively.

rules.name: Functional Accent
rules.body: Use green consistently for playback, selection and focus; sprite palette colors remain content.

dos: Preserve metadata access through the mobile disclosure.
Retain native control semantics and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not promote sprite colors into shell accents.
Do not add decorative elevation or oversized type that competes with the workspace.
